cell_type.evidence: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) are self-renewing multipotent cells which hold great potential in regenerative medicine and tissue engineering.

material_type: ESC-derived MSC have been phenotyped and show classic MSC behavior. They are plastic-adherent, show trilineage differentiation and express MSC-typical surface markers (CD73, CD90, CD105).

sample_source.evidence: ESC-MSC and BM-MSC were maintained in DMEM low glucose supplemented with 10% FBS, GlutaMax and 1% penicillin/streptomycin.

sex: Since the origin ESC line is male, only male BM-MSC donors were selected.

species.evidence: inferred: patient samples were collected from donors

tissue.evidence: MSC were first isolated from bone-marrow but actually reside perivascular in a wide range of organs and tissues such as adipose tissue, skin, muscle, tendon, lungs, dental pulp, umbilical cord, placenta, with each population displaying individual differentiation potential and phenotype.
